query: What signals indicate a hardware incident is in the anomaly window?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: The focus is whether an incident is a hardware anomaly. incident_category directly encodes 'hardware' vs 'software'/'network'/etc., which is essentially the hardware-ness of the incident restated as a category. Knowing category=hardware largely determines the hardware side of the focus, so it leaks/restates rather than serving as an external predictor.

per_column.name: failure_mode
per_column.rationale: Failure modes like not_turning_on, overheating, physical_damage, flickering_display are characteristic of hardware faults while connection_failure/not_responding lean software/network. It is an external, non-deterministic descriptor plausibly carrying signal about hardware involvement without simply restating the focus label.

per_column.name: symptom_severity_signal
per_column.rationale: Symptom/severity categories (crash_shutdown, outage, error_message, performance_degradation) are observable descriptors that correlate differentially with hardware vs non-hardware causes. Not a component or deterministic function of the focus; plausibly predictive.

per_column.name: resolution_lag_band
per_column.rationale: Resolution lag is only knowable after the incident is resolved (post-outcome), so using it to predict whether it is in the anomaly window constitutes temporal leakage rather than an a-priori predictor.

per_column.name: affected_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope (individual_device, peripheral_device, server_room, building) is an external contextual variable that plausibly correlates with hardware incidents (physical devices/peripherals) without restating or being a deterministic function of the focus.

per_column.name: opener_to_closer_match
per_column.rationale: Whether the opener equals the closer is a generic process/administrative attribute with no plausible mechanistic link to hardware-ness or the anomaly window; no meaningful predictive signal for the focus.

per_column.name: software_update_related
per_column.rationale: A software-update flag is an external indicator that inversely signals hardware involvement (update-related issues lean software). It is not a restatement of the focus and plausibly carries discriminative signal.

judge.rationale: The set mixes legitimate external predictors (failure_mode, symptom_severity_signal, affected_scope, software_update_related) with problematic columns: incident_category effectively restates/leaks the hardware label, resolution_lag_band is post-outcome leakage, and opener_to_closer_match is irrelevant. The genuine predictors give moderate, plausibly independent leverage on hardware-ness, but the strongest-looking column (incident_category) fails the test, and leakage inflates apparent utility. Net incremental predictive value beyond original columns is moderate.
